name: Craft Cognizance Crystal [Item Creation]
body:
You can create psionic cognizance crystals that store power points.

Prerequisite: Manifester level 3rd.

Benefit: You can create a cognizance crystal. Doing so takes one day for each 1,000 gp in its base price. The base price of a cognizance crystal is equal to the highest-level power it could manifest using all its stored power points, squared, multiplied by 1,000 gp. To create a cognizance crystal, you must use up raw materials costing one-half its base price.
